extractAudio.title: Extract audio
extractAudio.subtitle: Pull the audio track out of a video file and save it as MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG, or FLAC.
extractAudio.success: Audio extracted. Use the download button to save it.
extractAudio.note: The extracted track keeps the source's full duration and quality. Videos with no audio will return a clear error.

levelHints.smallest: Maximum shrink for email and chat. Some visible quality loss on detailed footage.
levelHints.balanced: A good size-to-quality trade-off for most videos and social uploads.
levelHints.high_quality: Keeps the most detail. Smaller than the source, but not by as much.

videoCompressor.stripAudio: Remove the audio track for an even smaller file
videoCompressor.note: We re-encode the video at the chosen level. MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC with faststart for instant playback.

videoTrimmer.invalidRange: Set an end time later than the start time.
videoTrimmer.reencodeHint: Re-encoding cuts exactly at your times but is slower and may change the file size slightly.
videoTrimmer.note: We keep the original quality with a fast, lossless cut whenever possible (no re-encode).

videoTransform.preserveAspect: Preserve aspect ratio (fit within the box)
videoTransform.resizeNote: Leave one field blank to scale the other proportionally. Max 4096 px per side.
videoTransform.rotateNote: Fixes sideways or upside-down videos. 90° and 270° swap width and height.
videoTransform.cropNote: Enter the rectangle to keep, in pixels from the top-left corner. Width and height are required.

extractVideoOnly.title: Extract video (no audio)
extractVideoOnly.subtitle: Strip the audio track from a video file, keeping only the video stream.
extractVideoOnly.note: The video stream is stream-copied wherever possible — no quality loss. We re-encode only if the destination container needs it.

extractFrames.title: Extract frames
extractFrames.subtitle: Save individual frames from a video as PNG, JPG, or WebP images.
extractFrames.zipNote: Frames are bundled into a single ZIP for download. We cap the count to keep jobs fast and predictable; raise the limit if you really need more.
extractFrames.success: Frames extracted. Download the ZIP below.

captionTranslator.timingNote: Cue timing and ordering are preserved exactly — only the cue text is translated.
captionTranslator.translationFailed: Translation failed. Try a smaller file or a different target language.

stitchAudioToVideo.title: Stitch audio onto a video

stitchAudioToVideo.loopTrack: Loop this track to match the video length
stitchAudioToVideo.stitchFailed: Stitch failed. Check that your audio files are valid and try again.

aiVideoTools.title: AI Video Tools
aiVideoTools.tooltipIntro: AI Video Tools currently includes AI Frame Interpolation, which generates new in-between frames so motion plays back more smoothly.
aiVideoTools.tooltipBestFor: Best for taking 24/30fps footage up to 60fps or 60fps up to 120fps. This is GPU-heavy and currently always outputs MP4.
aiVideoTools.intro: AI frame interpolation creates in-between frames for smoother motion. Best for 24/30fps → 60fps or 60fps → 120fps clips.
aiVideoTools.gpuNote: This is GPU-heavy and currently outputs MP4. For long or 4K videos, use a lower max processing height first. This is different from basic FPS conversion — AI interpolation synthesizes new frames rather than duplicating them, and bypasses most other visual / temporal filters in v1.

frameInterpolation.preserveAudio: Preserve audio track from the source

notes.mp4: Output is always MP4 (H.264 + AAC) in v1.
notes.trim: Trim is disabled with AI frame interpolation in v1 — trim the clip separately first if needed.
notes.artifacts: Fast motion, scene cuts, hair, hands, wheels, and occlusions can show interpolation artifacts. Preview before publishing.

selector.fpsAssumption: frame estimate assumes 30fps — the server uses your video's real frame rate
selector.overRecommended: Selections longer than {{seconds}}s work, but processing time grows fast — shorter snippets compare just as well.
selector.overFrameBudget: This selection likely exceeds the {{maxFrames}}-frame cap at 30fps. If your video's real frame rate is higher than ~30fps, shorten the selection.

picker.frameGroup: Frame-by-Frame Enhancers — includes enhanced frames + video
picker.includeFramesHint: Adds every enhanced frame from the frame-by-frame models to the download, next to the videos.
picker.includeFramesWarning: Frames can multiply the download size — a 10s clip can add hundreds of large PNGs per model.
picker.noneSelected: Select at least one model to continue.

realesrgan.description: Fast GAN upscaler — the quick baseline every comparison should include.

swinir.description: Transformer-based real-world SR — strong textures, slower than Real-ESRGAN.

hat.description: Hybrid attention SR GAN — often the sharpest stills, the slowest of Group A.

basicvsrpp.description: Recurrent video SR — uses neighboring frames for temporal consistency.

rvrt.description: Recurrent video restoration transformer — strong detail with motion awareness.

vrt.description: Video restoration transformer — top quality on many clips, by far the slowest.

picker.precleanToggleHint: Removes compression artifacts, noise, and motion blur without synthesizing new detail — run before enhancement.
picker.precleanOrderNote: Cleanup always runs artifact removal → denoise → deblur, each on the previous result, regardless of selection order.

picker.fbcnnQfHint: blank = automatic; lower assumes heavier compression
picker.faceToggleHint: Adds GFPGAN and/or CodeFormer to reconstruct faces.
picker.fidelityHint: Lower = prettier, higher = closer to the input. Default 0.70.
picker.chainToggle: Chain: re-run face models on each upscaled result
picker.chainHint: Also produces a face-enhanced version of every upscaler's output, in addition to running on the source.
picker.generativeWarning: Face enhancement is a generative reconstruction — enhanced faces are synthesized for clarity and leads, NOT a faithful recovery for identification.
picker.noneSelected: Select at least one model to continue.
picker.overBudget: That selection would produce more than the {{max}} output maximum. Deselect some models or turn off chaining.

scunet.description: Blind real-noise denoising — PSNR variant, no hallucinated texture (1x).

realesrgan.description: Fast GAN upscaler — the quick baseline every comparison should include.

swinir.description: Transformer-based real-world SR — strong textures, slower than Real-ESRGAN.

hat.description: Hybrid attention SR GAN — often the sharpest result.

gfpgan.description: GFPGAN v1.4 face restoration — generative reconstruction.

codeformer.description: CodeFormer face restoration with a fidelity dial — generative reconstruction.
